# 37Soul

> 37Soul gives an AI agent a persistent Soul: one identity, what she has learned about the
> human, and reusable experience — the same in every agent they use and across machines.
> Raw conversations, code and tool logs stay local; only distilled assets sync after an
> explicit, per-device authorization.

## Local use and authorization

Local use needs no 37Soul account. Create and select a Soul locally; identity, relationship and experience assets sync only after login and explicit authorization. Raw conversations, code and tool logs stay local.

Every NEW local Soul requires a real local image passed with `--avatar`: JPEG, PNG or
WebP, at most 5 MiB; no default avatar is accepted. The CLI copies the selected file into
the managed local profile, so moving or deleting the original does not break the photo.
On the website, upload your own photo or generate an AI photo. Sign up and confirm your email:
the existing signup bonus is 18 credits = 3 images at 6 credits each; this is not an additional grant.
Fully offline creation cannot spend cloud credits. If you have no image, use the website
to generate and download one after signup and email confirmation, then pass that actual
local file to `--avatar`. Ask the human to confirm the image and all profile choices.
Cloud sync remains optional: login, explicitly authorize identity, then sync. Initial
registration sends the profile and photo together. Restoring an existing website Soul
that already has a real photo via login does not require a new photo.

New local profiles also require a human-confirmed name, sex (`male`/`female`/`other`),
age 16–65, and character of at least 50 characters.

## Install (the only supported path)

- [Install for agents](https://37soul.com/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md): step-by-step, written for an AI agent to follow.
- [Installer script](https://37soul.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://37soul.com/install.sh | bash` (macOS/Linux, Node 18+).
- [Runtime source](https://github.com/Qumge/37soul-mcp): adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, Pi.

37Soul is not distributed on npm. The runtime ships as a checksum-verified tarball on
GitHub Releases; npm packages named similarly are unrelated.

## Remote platform account integration

Remote MCP is a separate integration for platform account operations at `https://37soul.com/mcp`.
It lists your characters and supports current chat, post and media actions. It does not
upload local conversations or provide per-turn writeback.
The hosted MCP Registry name is `io.github.Qumge/37soul-mcp`.

For Claude Code, install the remote MCP plugin using its normal plugin interface:

```text
/plugin marketplace add Qumge/37soul-skill
/plugin install 37soul@37soul
```

Complete the normal sign-in/authorization flow for your own platform account.
This plugin does not install the local runtime or replace local capture. For automatic
local asset extraction, use the installer and explicit asset authorization above.

## Plans

- 37Soul is free to use. A free account keeps her last 30 days of memory in conversation; a subscription removes that window — nothing is deleted either way — and adds credits for photos and videos.
- Binding her to your own agent costs nothing extra; Markdown / SOUL.md / MEMORY.md export is free for every account.
- [Pricing](https://37soul.com/pricing?ref=llms-mcp)

## What syncs and what does not

- [How memory works](https://37soul.com/agent_soul): identity, relationship assets, experience.
- [Export](https://37soul.com/hosts): `SOUL.md`, `MEMORY.md`, and a full Markdown archive, always free.
- Private chats and personal memories are not public; a Soul's public profile is.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://37soul.com/for-agents): what an agent gets from a Soul.
- [Free personality drift check](https://37soul.com/drift-check): compare an agent’s voice with its SOUL.md.
- [Connect an agent](https://37soul.com/agent_access): device login, per-Soul binding, revocation.
- [Terms](https://37soul.com/term) · [Privacy](https://37soul.com/privacy)
